name: TempleOS for Hermes
title: TempleOS for Hermes
tagline: A local TempleOS-family guest in QEMU. The Hermes agent and you share one live screen.

related_repos.name: mojomast/temple-of-hermes
related_repos.note: Default guest OS. Public-domain TempleOS-family ISO with an 18-entry home launcher, HBBS/1 boards over a COM2 serial modem, and a COM1 agent handshake. See source-guest.md. Official ISO is a GitHub release asset, not bundled in the plugin.

stats.tokens_note: README: evals/measure_schemas.py prints one integer: o200k tokens of the four tool schemas. This tree measures 972 o200k. The count must stay unchanged (delta 0) when docs or tool descriptions change; still four tools, under the ~2,000 budget.
stats.tests_note: README documents pytest and Node tests, plus optional live-QEMU smokes gated by TEMPLEOS_SMOKE=1, but does not publish a test count.

features: Four tools: templeos_vm, templeos_screen, templeos_input, templeos_files
Default guest is Temple of Hermes 0.1.2; optional TinkerOS 5.20-rc10, stock TempleOS 5.03, or ZealOS
Shared live screen in a Hermes Desktop pane; take control / hand back
Networking is always off (-nic none); QEMU and ISOs are not bundled; ISOs are fetched from official pinned URLs and SHA-256 verified
HD Terry companion in the pane (original fan tribute, 2017 cap look); Hide Terry / Quotes controls
Optional HBBS/1 chat bridge is off by default; destination is the allow-list name bbs
use_cases: Boot Temple of Hermes 0.1.2 and share the live guest screen with Hermes in the Desktop pane
Let the agent type HolyC or shell commands while you watch, or take control and hand the keyboard back
Switch guest OS from the pane's Guest OS picker (Temple of Hermes, TinkerOS, TempleOS 5.03, ZealOS) and reboot into it
Read the screen as text or as a PNG (look defaults to 640×480) and push or pull files over the framed COM1 protocol
Open the 18-entry home launcher in Temple of Hermes — click an icon or press its shortcut, then return to the launcher when the app exits
Use HBBS/1 boards inside the guest over the COM2 serial modem, with no NIC on the VM
install:
Requires qemu-system-x86_64 and qemu-img on PATH (for example sudo apt install qemu-system-x86 qemu-utils).

hermes plugins install mojomast/hermes-templeos --ref c61d00eb4d36c5e3c7cd57a2985985aed8db42f0 --enable
hermes plugins doctor templeos

No ISO is bundled. Doctor fetches the official Temple of Hermes 0.1.2 ISO from its GitHub release and verifies SHA-256. Primary host is Linux x86_64; Apple Silicon and Windows are untested. Terry is an original fan tribute with no official TempleOS affiliation.
